request.spec:
Sometimes I add a person before I know all their numbers. If alpha, beta or gamma is missing
for a person, then thrust, drift, momentum and tier should all show "n/a" for that person until
I fill the missing numbers in.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for this implementation's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Sometimes I add a person before I know all their numbers. If alpha, beta or gamma is missing
for a person, then thrust, drift, momentum and tier should all show "n/a" for that person until
I fill the missing numbers in.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
If a person is missing alpha, beta or gamma, their thrust, drift, momentum and tier now all show "n/a" until the missing numbers are filled in. The test passes with `bin/e2e`, and the replay of earlier test data passed as well.

**What changed:**
- **Server** (`Person.java`): thrust, drift, momentum and tier now each wait for all three numbers. Before, each one only needed its own inputs, so drift (gamma − alpha) still showed 7 for a person with no beta. The test caught this.
- **Front end** (`people.ts`): those four columns now show "n/a" when the value is blank, instead of an empty cell.

**One addition you didn't ask for:** before this change, alpha was required when adding a person and couldn't be changed afterwards. That meant a missing alpha could never be filled in. So I made alpha optional on the add form and added a "Set alpha" box and Save button on each row, matching the existing beta and gamma ones. The new test ids are `person-alpha-input` and `person-alpha-save`. No existing test ids were changed or removed. If you'd rather keep alpha required, these changes are easy to drop.
